title: Structure engineering principle
description: A white section split unevenly: at the right a huge two-line neo-grotesk heading, a long empty gap, a 20px lead and calm mono paragraphs; at the lower left a landscape image (a line drawing on the original) sitting on the baseline. Heading, lead, text and image each fade up 48px as they come into view.
notes: uses the card colour as its background (pure white in the faithful theme) to set itself off from the paper sections
